title: Out of bounds?
content: A few weeks ago I was in the mall and found an area that was empty of people. I remember thinking that was strange cause usually when I'm in the mall, there are people literally everywhere. All of the storefronts were lit up but completely empty. There was a second floor area but no way to access it except for a ladder that was kinda hidden off to the side. I climbed up and there were all these signs leaning against the wall that all had some variation of "caution" and "danger" on them. I went around a corner and the area opened up to a warehouse sort of area and the racks were filled to the brim with boxes. I stopped at this point because I got an overwhelming feeling of fear and danger like I absolutely should not have been there. I immediately turned around but I was wondering if anyone else has stumbled into this area and did it make you feel the same way? I can't stop thinking about it.
